checkpoints.note: First vulnerability-relevant project statement. When `parse_addr_spec` sees the attacker-controlled semicolon in the To-header body, it fixes the body length and hands the parameter substring plus the original buffer end pointer into `parse_to_param`.

For the witnessed input, the trailing backslash is the final byte, so entering this branch means `tmp == end - 1`. The fix adds the missing `if(tmp+1>=end)` guard immediately before the read, which is the source-level obligation absent in the vulnerable version.
